sources.title: Sacramento District Attorney publishes ALPR database-access directive
sources.summary: The Sacramento County District Attorney's publicly hosted ALPR data-access directive states that its office does not employ or deploy ALPR readers, but may access ALPR data collected by other entities. It requires official law-enforcement purposes, case identifiers for queries, agency-manager authorization and periodic audits. The website's January 9, 2026 timestamp is a page timestamp, not independently verified policy-effective date, proof of Flock data access, or an audit of actual searches.
